d:
Get into the festive spirit with this epic Dhol Mashup of Aaya re Toofan and Deva Shree Ganesha for Ganesh Chaturthi 2025! Listen to the latest Ganpati songs and dance your heart out to the beats of this amazing fusion.
Original Song credits:
Song: Aaya re Toofan
Song Composed, Produced, and Arranged by A.R. Rahman
Vocals - A.R. Rahman, Vaishali Samant
Lyrics - Irshaad Kamil, Kshitij
Song Title- Deva Shree Ganesha
Movie- Agneepath (2012)
